# db-worker thread-api Reference

> Generated from source at revision `be800f1711`. Every method below is reachable over [`POST /v1/invoke`](db-worker-http-api.md#post-v1invoke) as `thread-api/<name>`.

|---|---|
| Methods declared | 164 (161 worker-side, 3 main-thread) |
| With hand-written notes | 15 |

## Drift findings

These are inconsistencies between code and code, or code and notes. They are regenerated on every run and should be fixed at the source.

| Kind | Method | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| `allowlisted-but-undefined` | `:thread-api/get-version` | listed in non-repo-methods but no def-thread-api defines it; invoking it fails |

## How to read the table

- **Params** — the declaration's parameter vector. The first parameter is `repo` for every repo-bound method.
- **Repo** — `●` means the first argument must match the worker's bound graph (`409 repo-mismatch` otherwise) and lock ownership is asserted.
- **Renderer / CLI** — occurrences of the method name in `src/main/frontend` (excluding the worker) and in the CLI (`cli/lib/*.ml`, `src/main/logseq/cli`). Zero in both usually means dead or driven by another worker-side path.
- **Notes** — hand-written, from `thread-api-notes.edn`. Absent means nobody has verified it yet; treat as internal.

Methods under **main-thread** files are the reverse direction — defined in the renderer and invoked *by* the worker (`<invoke-main-thread`). They are not reachable over HTTP and are listed for completeness.

Worker broadcasts arrive as `data: {"type": ..., "payload": <transit>}`; the decoded payload is usually a `[type payload]` pair. **Handled** means `frontend/handler/worker.cljs` has a `defmethod` for it — the renderer-facing contract. **Emitted from** lists worker files that send it.

| Event | Handled by renderer | Emitted from |
|---|:-:|---|
| `:add-repo` | ● | `src/main/frontend/worker/sync/download.cljs` |
| `:asset-file-write-finish` | ● | `src/main/frontend/worker/sync/assets.cljs` |
| `:backup-file` | ● |  |
| `:capture-error` | ● | `src/main/frontend/worker/db_core.cljs`<br>`src/main/frontend/worker/db_listener.cljs`<br>`src/main/frontend/worker/sync/apply_txs.cljs` |
| `:export-current-db` | ● |  |
| `:log` | ● | `src/main/frontend/worker/db/validate.cljs` |
| `:notification` | ● | `src/main/frontend/worker/db/migrate.cljs`<br>`src/main/frontend/worker/db/validate.cljs`<br>`src/main/frontend/worker/db_core.cljs`<br>`src/main/frontend/worker/handler/export.cljs`<br>`src/main/frontend/worker/handler/transaction.cljs` |
| `:notify-existing-file` | ● |  |
| `:record-worker-client-id` | ● | `src/main/frontend/worker/db_core.cljs` |
| `:remote-graph-gone` | ● |  |
| `:rtc-asset-upload-download-progress` | ● | `src/main/frontend/worker/sync/assets.cljs` |
| `:rtc-log` | ● | `src/main/frontend/worker/sync/log_and_state.cljs`<br>`src/main/frontend/worker/sync/upload.cljs` |
| `:rtc-sync-state` | ● | `src/main/frontend/worker/sync.cljs`<br>`src/main/frontend/worker/sync/apply_txs.cljs`<br>`src/main/frontend/worker/sync/handle_message.cljs` |
| `:sync-conflicts-updated` | ● | `src/main/frontend/worker/handler/sync.cljs`<br>`src/main/frontend/worker/sync/apply_txs.cljs` |
| `:sync-db-changes` | ● | `src/main/frontend/worker/db_listener.cljs` |

## Outliner ops (`thread-api/apply-outliner-ops`)

Each op is a vector `[op-keyword & args]` validated against the malli `op-schema` in `deps/outliner/src/logseq/outliner/op.cljs`. **Semantic** ops are the ones undo/redo and sync treat as intent-preserving.

| Op | Args | Semantic |
|---|---|:-:|
| `:save-block` | `block option` | ● |
| `:insert-blocks` | `blocks block-id option` | ● |
| `:apply-template` | `block-id block-id option` | ● |
| `:delete-blocks` | `block-ids option` | ● |
| `:move-blocks` | `block-ids block-id option` | ● |
| `:move-blocks-up-down` | `block-ids :boolean` | ● |
| `:indent-outdent-blocks` | `block-ids :boolean option` | ● |
| `:collapse-expand-blocks` | `blocks option` |  |
| `:upsert-property` | `maybe-property-id schema option` | ● |
| `:set-block-property` | `block-id property-id value` |  |
| `:remove-block-property` | `block-id property-id` |  |
| `:delete-property-value` | `block-id property-id value` |  |
| `:batch-delete-property-value` | `block-ids property-id value` |  |
| `:create-property-text-block` | `maybe-block-id property-id value option` |  |
| `:collapse-expand-block-property` | `block-id property-id :boolean` |  |
| `:batch-set-property` | `block-ids property-id value option` |  |
| `:batch-remove-property` | `block-ids property-id` |  |
| `:class-add-property` | `class-id property-id` |  |
| `:class-remove-property` | `class-id property-id` |  |
| `:upsert-closed-value` | `property-id option` |  |
| `:delete-closed-value` | `property-id block-id` |  |
| `:add-existing-values-to-closed-values` | `property-id values` |  |
| `:batch-import-edn` | `import-edn option` |  |
